description: Large resting limit orders ("walls") in the order book within ±range_pct of the price, sorted by size in USD. source "binance" = Binance spot book; "all" = 15 books from 10 exchanges aggregated (Binance, OKX, Bybit, Kraken, Bitfinex, Coinbase, Bitstamp, Gemini, Deribit, Gate).

limit.description: Maximum number of walls to return (1 to 50)

pair.description: Coin traded against USDT: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, BNB, DOGE, ZEC or NEAR

range_pct.description: How far from the price to look, in % (0.1 to 30)

source.description: "binance" = Binance spot book only; "all" = 15 books from 10 exchanges aggregated

name: order_book_walls
title: Order book walls
